# Harvard Health

> > Trusted health information and medical insights from Harvard Medical School faculty and affiliated hospitals including Massachusetts General Hospital, Brigham and Women's Hospital, Boston Children's Hospital, and Beth Israel Deaconess Medical Center.

Harvard Health Publishing provides evidence-based health content authored by physicians, researchers, and specialists across diverse medical disciplines. The site features expert contributors from Harvard Medical School and its teaching hospitals, covering topics from pediatric neurodevelopment to cardiovascular disease, oncology, mental health, and health equity.

## Key Topics

- Harvard Medical School
- Massachusetts General Hospital
- Brigham and Women's Hospital
- Boston Children's Hospital
- Beth Israel Deaconess Medical Center
- Clinical Psychology
- Pediatric Medicine
- Neurodevelopmental Disorders
- Health Equity
- Emergency Medicine
- Endocrinology
- Oncology
- Cardiovascular Health
- Mental Health
- Medical Research

## Pediatric Medicine and Neurodevelopment

- [Nicole Baumer, MD, MEd - Harvard Health](https://www.health.harvard.edu/authors/nicole-baumer-md-med): Child neurologist specializing in Down syndrome, autism, and ADHD
- [Rebecca P. Thomas, PhD - Harvard Health](https://www.health.harvard.edu/authors/rebecca-p-thomas-phd): Clinical psychologist at Boston Children's Hospital, neurodevelopment focus
- [Erica H. Lee, PhD - Harvard Health](https://www.health.harvard.edu/authors/erica-h-lee-phd): Clinical psychologist focused on pediatric mental health and resilience
- [Shannon Manzi, PharmD - Harvard Health](https://www.health.harvard.edu/authors/shannon-manzi-pharmd): Pediatric pharmacist at Boston Children's Hospital, emergency medicine

## Specialty Medicine and Surgery

- [Christopher Estiverne, MD - Harvard Health](https://www.health.harvard.edu/authors/christopher-estiverne-md): Nephrologist at Brigham and Women's Hospital specializing in kidney care
- [Daniel M. Vu, MD - Harvard Health](https://www.health.harvard.edu/authors/daniel-m-vu-md): Ophthalmologist at Mass Eye and Ear specializing in glaucoma
- [James Naples, MD - Harvard Health](https://www.health.harvard.edu/authors/james-naples-md): Otolaryngologist specializing in hearing loss and cochlear implants
- [Ted A. James, MD - Harvard Health](https://www.health.harvard.edu/authors/ted-a-james-md): Breast surgical oncologist at Beth Israel Deaconess Medical Center
- [Martina Porter, MD - Harvard Health](https://www.health.harvard.edu/authors/martina-porter-md): Dermatologist researching immune-mediated skin conditions at BIDMC

## Chronic Disease Management

- [Marc Gregory Yu, MD - Harvard Health](https://www.health.harvard.edu/authors/marc-gregory-yu-md): Endocrinologist at Joslin Diabetes Center researching Type 1 diabetes
- [Samuel Z. Goldhaber, MD - Harvard Health](https://www.health.harvard.edu/authors/samuel-z-goldhaber-md): Cardiologist at Brigham and Women's specializing in thrombosis research
- [Florencia Halperin, MD - Harvard Health](https://www.health.harvard.edu/authors/florencia-halperin-md): Weight management and bariatric surgery specialist at Brigham and Women's
- [Melanie Pogach, MD - Harvard Health](https://www.health.harvard.edu/authors/melanie-pogach-md): Sleep medicine specialist at Beth Israel Deaconess Medical Center

## Emergency and Critical Care

- [Susan Farrell, MD - Harvard Health](https://www.health.harvard.edu/authors/susan-farrell-md): Emergency medicine and medical toxicology specialist at Partners Healthcare

## Health Equity and Public Health

- [David Scales, MPhil, MD, PhD - Harvard Health](https://www.health.harvard.edu/authors/david-scales-mphil-md-phd): Physician focused on global health, refugee health, and health equity
- [Sabra L. Katz-Wise, PhD - Harvard Health](https://www.health.harvard.edu/authors/sabra-l-katz-wise-phd): LGBTQ+ health researcher focusing on gender identity and sexual orientation
- [Richard Frank, PhD - Harvard Health](https://www.health.harvard.edu/authors/richard-frank-phd): Health economist specializing in mental health and substance abuse policy

## Rehabilitation and Nutrition

- [Gayle Lang, OTR/L, CHT, MS - Harvard Health](https://www.health.harvard.edu/authors/gayle-lang-otrl-cht-ms): Occupational and hand therapist at Brigham & Women's Hospital
- [Carol Sullivan, MS, RD, CSO, LDN - Harvard Health](https://www.health.harvard.edu/authors/carol-sullivan-ms-rd-cso-ldn): Oncology nutrition specialist at MGH Cancer Center
